rule_definition: Deduplicate by instrument_id + trade_id when trade_id is present and unique.
failure_condition: Same instId/tradeId appears with different timestamp/price/size/side.
notes: If conflicts exist, quarantine rows and stop broad audit.

rule_definition: If tradeId uniqueness is not sufficient, use instId + tradeId + ts + px + sz + side.
required_fields: instId, tradeId, ts, px, sz, side
failure_condition: Composite duplicates cannot be explained by repeated pages.

rule_definition: Allow overlapping pages during pagination but remove duplicates before aggregation.
failure_condition: Pagination creates unbounded duplicates or inconsistent order.

rule_definition: Report long intervals with no trades relative to market liquidity and expected active hours.
notes: Crypto trades 24/7; zero-trade gaps in liquid markets are suspicious.

rule_definition: Track requested cursors and first/last tradeId/ts per page to identify skipped ranges.
failure_condition: Cursor progression is unstable or skips requested interval.
notes: Stop before full 19-market audit if unstable.

rule_definition: Each 4h bucket outputs complete/incomplete with reason.
failure_condition: Many incomplete buckets in sample window.
